$comment: Verifiable sample of a signed WorldMonitor webhook delivery. Verify signatureV2 over the timestamp, delivery id, event and exact body bytes before you register a live webhook. Use the fixed timestamp as the test clock. The secret here is a public fixture. Each live subscription gets its own secret once from POST /api/v2/shipping/webhooks.
description: Signed webhook delivery verification fixture (HMAC-SHA256, legacy and V2 signatures).
verify: Compute 'sha256=' + hex(HMAC_SHA256(key=secret, message=body)) over the EXACT bytes of the `body` string below — do NOT re-parse or re-serialize the JSON, and use `secret` verbatim as the key (do not hex-decode it). The result must equal `signature` for legacy verification. For replay protection, require signatureV2 and the timestamp as described in verifyV2.
verifyV2: Compute sha256= + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp.deliveryId.event.body)) using the exact header strings and body bytes. Compare with X-WM-Signature-V2 in constant time. Reject timestamps more than 300 seconds in the past or future and dedupe verified delivery IDs. This fixed sample needs its own timestamp as the test clock.
